name.text: Determine the type of variable height is

questiontext.text:

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

[[ if test="member(1, ta_index)" ]]

A quantitative variable is a type of variable in statistics and research that represents measurable quantities with numerical values. These variables are used to express quantities that can be counted, measured, or compared on a numerical scale.

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(2, ta_index)" ]]

Continuous variables can take on any value within a certain range, and they often have an infinite number of possible values. These variables are typically measured with great precision and can include fractional or decimal values.

[[/ if ]]
